# Test fixtures (real media)

Regenerate with `node scripts/make-fixtures.mjs` (downloads pinned sdists, verifies SHA-256, extracts files, and
generates media with the project's own ffmpeg.wasm and Chromium). Used only by tests — never shipped in the site.

| pgp/rfc9580/*.msg, *.asc | The test vectors of **RFC 9580 (OpenPGP), Appendix A**, as rPGP 0.21.1 ships them in its test data (crates.io SHA-256 of the crate checked by cargo): `v6-key.asc` — the v6 Ed25519 / X25519 secret key of Annex A.4; `v6-seipdv1.asc`, `v6-seipdv2.asc` — "hello world\n" encrypted to it (SEIPD v1, and v2 with AEAD); `v6-clearsigned.asc` — "hello world" clear-signed with it; `aead-ocb.msg`, `aead-eax.msg`, `aead-gcm.msg` — "Hello, world!" encrypted with the password "password" and AEAD; `argon2-aes256.msg` — the same with Argon2 (the RFC's parameters: 2 GiB of memory). RFC code components: Revised BSD (IETF Trust); rPGP's test data: MIT / Apache-2.0. |
| hash/reference.json | Made by `scripts/make-hash-reference.py`: the digests of 38 inputs (texts, generated bytes of 1 B – 3 MiB + 7 at block edges, 1,000,000 × "a") under 23 algorithms, from implementations that share no code with hash-wasm — Python's hashlib (OpenSSL), zlib, pycryptodomex, the `blake3`, `xxhash` and `crc32c` packages, CRC-64 checked with liblzma. Generated data, no licence. |
| barcode/reference.json | Made by `scripts/make-barcode-reference.py`: 1,005 digit strings (7, 11, 12, 13 digits, seeded) with their GS1 check digits from python-stdnum's `ean.calc_check_digit`. Generated data, no licence. |
| archives/rar3-subdirs.rar, rar5-psw.rar, rar5-hpsw.rar | From the test files of **rarfile 4.5** (PyPI sdist, `test/files/`; ISC licence, Marko Kreen): a RAR3 archive with folders and a Unicode name; RAR5 archives whose files (psw) or headers too (hpsw) are encrypted with the password "password". |
